audience: developers and agencies who host websites on servers managed with RunCloud

useCases.title: Check server health, memory and disk space
useCases.text: The AI lists your servers with their online state and reads the latest health sample: memory, disk and load average. It also reads CPU, cores and uptime.

useCases.title: List the web apps and domains on a server
useCases.text: The AI lists the web applications of a server with PHP version and type, and the domain names of each app. It can read the DNS records a domain needs.

useCases.title: Check an SSL certificate, then renew or issue it
useCases.text: The AI reads a web app's SSL certificate with provider and validity. It can renew a Let's Encrypt certificate or issue a new one.

useCases.title: Check that backups ran and succeeded
useCases.text: The AI lists the backup instances with what they cover, frequency and status, and the snapshots of one backup with run date, status and size.

useCases.title: Start, restart or reload a server service
useCases.text: The AI lists the services of a server with their running state, then starts, restarts or reloads one, for example nginx. A restart briefly interrupts the sites behind it.

useCases.title: Deploy the latest code of a web app
useCases.text: The AI reads the Git deployment setup, then forces a Git deployment or an atomic deployment now. It can list atomic deployments with their status.
